meta.method: Autocomplete presence, not search volume. On October 7, 2026 every keyword was sent to Google (suggestqueries, en-US), Bing (osjson) and DuckDuckGo (ac), and each engine was marked when it suggested the exact phrase for any probe. Engines only autocomplete queries people actually type, so a mark means real demand. No mark means low or no demand, not proof of zero.
